- weighted fusion slightly outperforms concat (0.725 vs 0.721)

- config_042: singleprofile, scvi_n200, imagenet_vit_l, no aggregation, weighted

- config_042: singleprofile, scvi_n200, imagenet_vit_l, weighted

- transformer + concat: 0.720714 (config_017)
- avgpool + concat: 0.715020 (config_034)
- avgpool + weighted: 0.706245 (config_026)
